task.prompt: Compare DataHub Cloud's Pro and Team plans for a 25-seat team billed annually. Which plan is cheaper per year, and by how much?
task.expected: Team ($11,700/yr for 25 seats) is cheaper than Pro ($14,700/yr) by $3,000 per year.

outcome.answer: Billed annually for 25 seats, the Team plan costs $11,700/year (25 x $39 x 12) versus $14,700/year for Pro (25 x $49 x 12), so Team is cheaper by $3,000 per year. Pro's extra cost covers SSO, audit logs, and 90-day version history.

steps.name: plan
steps.input: 1) Get per-seat prices for DataHub Cloud's Pro and Team plans from the official pricing page. 2) Compute the 25-seat annual cost of each plan. 3) Compare and report the difference.
steps.output: Plan set. Locating the official pricing page.

steps.name: web_search
steps.input: DataHub Cloud pricing Pro Team plan per seat annual billing
steps.output: [1] datahubcloud.com/pricing — Plans & Pricing | [2] saasradar.com — "DataHub Cloud plans compared (2025)" | [3] reddit.com — r/dataeng: "Is DataHub Cloud Pro worth it?"

steps.name: web_search
steps.input: DataHub Cloud Team plan price per user 2025
steps.output: [1] datahubcloud.com/pricing — Plans & Pricing | [2] saasradar.com — "DataHub Cloud plans compared (2025)" | [3] getapp-style listing — DataHub Cloud pricing overview
steps.note: Divergence: redundant follow-up query — the official pricing page was already result [1] of the first search.

steps.name: web_search
steps.input: DataHub Cloud Pro plan annual billing discount
steps.output: [1] datahubcloud.com/pricing — Plans & Pricing | [2] datahubcloud.com/blog — "Annual billing now saves 17%" | [3] saasradar.com — plans compared
steps.note: Second redundant query; still landing on the same page.

steps.name: select_result
steps.input: Open result [1]: datahubcloud.com/pricing — the vendor's own pricing page has the canonical numbers.

steps.name: open_page
steps.output: DataHub Cloud — Plans & Pricing. Team: $39 per user/month billed annually ($47 billed monthly). Pro: $49 per user/month billed annually ($59 billed monthly); adds SSO/SAML, audit logs, 90-day version history, priority support. Enterprise: contact sales.

steps.name: open_page
steps.output: saasradar.com: "DataHub Cloud's Team tier runs $39/user/mo on annual terms versus $49 for Pro. For most sub-50-seat teams the delta is SSO and audit logs."
steps.note: Confirmation read adds latency but no new information.

steps.name: final_answer
steps.input: Compose the final answer from the verified findings.
steps.output: Billed annually for 25 seats, the Team plan costs $11,700/year (25 x $39 x 12) versus $14,700/year for Pro (25 x $49 x 12), so Team is cheaper by $3,000 per year. Pro's extra cost covers SSO, audit logs, and 90-day version history.
